agent_explanation: Controller regulates pole angle (theta ~ -0.08 rad at step 676, margin 0.71, upright) but does not regulate cart position: cart starts with negative velocity and drifts monotonically left with velocity growing to -1.36 m/s while controller applies only ~0.77 N (far below 54 N limit). Rendered frames 600-676 confirm cart sliding left past the red track end marker with pole still upright. Removing the initial velocity removes the drift and the violation, proving the cause is uncorrected cart drift / missing cart-position feedback, not a pole instability or external push.
